body_md:
Five Jacksonville plumbing contractors with named owners have Certified Plumbing Contractor licenses listed Current, Active on a DBPR lookup page, all expiring 08/31/2028. Darley's Plumbing, Inc., Turner Plumbing Company, B & G Plumbing Co, and Hall and Sons Plumbing Inc are described as family-owned. Compare hours, service area, and stated services, then match the license number on the linked DBPR page before you hire.

## How we picked

License type, number, status, expiration, and licensure date were checked on the DBPR lookup page linked as each listing's source. All five are Certified Plumbing Contractors with status Current, Active and expiration 08/31/2028. Hours, area, years, owners, and services are only statements in the listing facts, including what a company site or business materials state. Those facts stay tied to the DBPR source link. No prices are in the facts.

## Quick picks

- **Best overall:** Turner Plumbing Company, 1903 Hendricks Avenue, Jacksonville, FL 32207, (904) 396-7044, owner Kendal Turner-Rohane, license CFC1430425, licensure date 10/14/2019. Stated facts used for this pick: history since 1942, fourth-generation family ownership, hours stated as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday, and a site statement that the company is bonded and insured. Stated work includes residential and commercial plumbing, emergency repairs, drain cleaning, water heaters, pipe replacement, and bathroom remodeling in Jacksonville, St. Augustine, Ponte Vedra, and Northeast Florida.
- **Best budget:** No listing includes a price, so no company is named as lower-cost. Call for a written estimate: Darley's Plumbing, Inc. (904) 727-1484; Turner Plumbing Company (904) 396-7044; B & G Plumbing Co (904) 223-3585; Hall and Sons Plumbing Inc 904-429-9747; Nolan Plumbing & Irrigation, Inc. 904-783-4321.
- **Best for irrigation, drainage, and septic work:** Nolan Plumbing & Irrigation, Inc., 12542 Woodcutter Road, Jacksonville, FL 32220, 904-783-4321, owner Jack W. Nolan, license CFC056813, licensure date 04/24/1995. The listing states plumbing, irrigation, and drainage in the Greater Jacksonville area. Business materials also describe septic, drainfield, pump, and well services and state wells are not drilled.

## Things to know before you go

Darley's Plumbing, Inc. (Carl L. Darley; CFC056702; licensure date 09/03/1993) states a primary area of Northeast Florida (Duval, St. Johns, Clay, Nassau, and Baker counties) and states services have been provided throughout Florida. It states the company opened in 1993 and has more than 30 years. Stated work is residential and commercial plumbing, remodeling, and new construction. It states plumbers are employees rather than subcontractors and do not work on commission.

B & G Plumbing Co (Gene C. Rover; CFC022593; licensure date 03/14/1982) states Northeast Florida, including Jacksonville, Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Ponte Vedra Beach, St. Augustine, Flagler Beach, Crescent Beach, Fernandina Beach, Vilano Beach, and Palm Coast. It states a family-owned plumbing and air-conditioning company since 1978, also lists Florida licenses CAC1814123 and CFCA022593, and states technicians are drug tested, reference checked, and trained.

Hall and Sons Plumbing Inc (Gary Hall and Jeremy Graves; CFC1425980; licensure date 07/24/2003) states Jacksonville, St. Johns, Clay, and surrounding counties. It states family-owned, veteran-operated residential and commercial plumbing, including repairs, new construction, water heaters, and fixtures. The company site states founded 6 years ago and serving Northeast Florida for 6 years, with a Florida filing date of 05/24/2018, and states more than four decades of combined experience.

Nolan Plumbing & Irrigation, Inc. materials state the business was established in 1988 as a sole proprietor, with a Florida corporation filing date of 02/13/1997.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses listed as active?

Yes. Each listing is a Certified Plumbing Contractor with status Current, Active, expiration 08/31/2028, and a DBPR lookup page as the source. Confirm the license number on that linked page before work starts.

### Who states 24-hour or emergency service?

Turner Plumbing Company states it is open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday. Darley's Plumbing, Inc. states 24-hour emergency service; regular office hours are not stated. B & G Plumbing Co states Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm, with emergency service available. Hours are not stated for Hall and Sons Plumbing Inc or Nolan Plumbing & Irrigation, Inc., so call before you go.

### Who is named as owner?

Carl L. Darley for Darley's Plumbing, Inc.; Kendal Turner-Rohane for Turner Plumbing Company; Gene C. Rover for B & G Plumbing Co; Gary Hall and Jeremy Graves for Hall and Sons Plumbing Inc; and Jack W. Nolan for Nolan Plumbing & Irrigation, Inc.
